ui-ux-design.name: UI/UX Design
ui-ux-design.headline: Design intuitive and user-friendly interfaces that make websites and applications easy to navigate. We create experiences that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction.
ui-ux-design.problem: Confusing flows quietly bleed users at every step.

faq.question: Do you do user testing?
faq.answer: Yes, we conduct usability testing sessions with real users to validate design decisions and identify friction points.

faq.question: What tools do you design in?
faq.answer: We primarily design in Figma, but can also work in Sketch or Adobe XD based on your team's preference.

faq.question: How many revision rounds?
faq.answer: Typically 2-3 revision rounds for UI design, with additional iterations during wireframing to ensure we're aligned before visual design begins.

web-design.name: Website Design
web-design.headline: Create modern, visually appealing websites that reflect your brand and build trust with your audience. Every design is tailored to your business and optimized for all devices.
web-design.problem: Generic templates don't build trust. Visitors judge credibility in seconds.

faq.question: How many pages?
faq.answer: Depends on your needs — typically 5-10 core pages for most businesses, with templates for additional pages.

faq.question: Do you write the content too?
faq.answer: We can connect you with copywriters, or work with content you provide. We focus on design and structure.

faq.question: Can I update it myself later?
faq.answer: Yes, we build on CMS platforms that let your team update content without touching code.

landing-page-design.name: Landing Page Design
landing-page-design.headline: Design high-converting landing pages for marketing campaigns, product launches, and lead generation, focused on turning visitors into customers.
landing-page-design.problem: Sending ad traffic to a generic homepage kills conversion rate.

faq.question: Can you write the copy?
faq.answer: We partner with conversion copywriters, or can work with copy you provide. The design is built around your messaging.

faq.question: Do you set up A/B testing?
faq.answer: We design pages with A/B testing in mind and can set up basic variants, or integrate with your testing platform.

faq.question: Turnaround time?
faq.answer: Typically 1-2 weeks for a focused landing page, faster if you have copy and assets ready.

mobile-app-design.name: Mobile App Design
mobile-app-design.headline: Design clean and intuitive mobile app interfaces that provide a seamless experience across Android and iOS devices.
mobile-app-design.problem: Users abandon apps in the first session if onboarding is confusing.

faq.question: iOS, Android or both?
faq.answer: We can design for iOS, Android, or both — often designing once with platform-specific adaptations.

faq.question: Do you design onboarding flows?
faq.answer: Yes, onboarding is critical. We design complete user flows from first launch to core value delivery.

faq.question: Handoff format for developers?
faq.answer: We provide organized Figma files with components, design tokens, and export-ready assets for smooth developer handoff.

web-redesign.name: Website Redesign
web-redesign.headline: Refresh outdated websites with a modern design, improved performance, and a better user experience while preserving your business identity.
web-redesign.problem: An outdated site quietly loses trust and search ranking.
approach: Identify what to keep vs. rebuild

faq.question: Will we lose our SEO rankings?
faq.answer: No — we implement proper 301 redirects, preserve URL structures where possible, and maintain on-page SEO elements.

faq.question: Can we keep some existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes, we audit existing content and identify what to keep, update, or rebuild based on performance and alignment with new design.

faq.question: How long does migration take?
faq.answer: Typically 4-8 weeks depending on site size and complexity. We plan migration carefully to minimize downtime.

branding.name: Brand Identity
branding.headline: Build a consistent visual identity with professional logos, colors, typography, and brand guidelines that help your business stand out.
branding.problem: Inconsistent visuals across platforms make you look unprofessional.

faq.question: Do you design business cards/social templates too?
faq.answer: Yes, we create templates for business cards, social media, presentations, and other collateral to ensure consistency.

faq.question: How many logo concepts?
faq.answer: Typically 3-5 initial concepts, then refinement to 1-2 final directions with variations for different use cases.

faq.question: Timeline?
faq.answer: Usually 3-4 weeks for a complete brand identity, from discovery to final brand guidelines delivery.

web-development.name: Website Development
web-development.headline: Develop fast, secure, and responsive websites using modern technologies. Our websites are optimized for performance, scalability, and search engines.
web-development.problem: A beautiful design that's slow or breaks on mobile costs you customers.

faq.question: What platforms do you build on?
faq.answer: We build on modern frameworks like Next.js/React for custom sites, or CMS platforms like WordPress and Webflow based on your needs.

faq.question: Do you handle hosting?
faq.answer: We can recommend and set up hosting, or deploy to platforms like Vercel, Netlify, or your preferred infrastructure.

faq.question: Post-launch bug fixes included?
faq.answer: Yes, we include a warranty period for bug fixes post-launch, with ongoing support options available.

software-development.name: Custom Software Development
software-development.headline: Build software tailored to your business processes. We develop secure, scalable solutions that automate workflows and improve operational efficiency.
software-development.problem: Generic SaaS tools force you to bend your workflow to fit them.

faq.question: Do you build the full stack?
faq.answer: Yes, we handle full-stack development — frontend, backend, database, and API design as needed for your project.

faq.question: How is pricing scoped?
faq.answer: We scope based on feature requirements and complexity. After discovery, we provide a detailed proposal with clear milestones.

faq.question: Do you provide ongoing dev support?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer ongoing development support for feature additions, maintenance, and scaling as your product grows.

mobile-app-development.name: Mobile App Development
mobile-app-development.headline: Develop high-performance Android and iOS applications that deliver smooth user experiences and support your business goals.
mobile-app-development.problem: A slow, buggy app gets uninstalled — and rated publicly.

faq.question: Native or cross-platform?
faq.answer: We recommend based on your needs — React Native/Flutter for cross-platform efficiency, or native (Swift/Kotlin) for maximum performance.

faq.question: Do you handle app store submission?
faq.answer: Yes, we handle the technical submission process and guide you through App Store and Play Store requirements.

faq.question: Post-launch support?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide post-launch support for bug fixes, updates, and feature additions to keep your app running smoothly.
